source: NOAA nClimGrid-Daily county area averages, EpiNOAA v1.0.0 scaled

methods.temperatures: Mean of 30 annual calendar-month means, converted to °F. Coldest and hottest months use monthly mean temperature; ties use the earliest month.
methods.days: Mean number of days per selected calendar month or year where county-area daily high ≥ named °F threshold, daily low < named °F threshold, or daily precipitation ≥ 0.254 mm (wet) or < 0.254 mm (dry). Leap days included.
methods.coverage: Contiguous United States. Requires exactly one valid county record per calendar day in all 360 months. County boundaries follow the source FIPS vintage.
methods.precision: Published figures are rounded to the nearest tenth.

monthlySource.coverage: Alaska and Hawaii, temperature only. Direct county FIPS joins. All 360 monthly averages required for each temperature element.
monthlySource.name: NOAA nClimDiv county monthly, v1.0.0-20261105
